scalars.scalar_value: Hands-on experience with penguin health assessments, restraint and treatments

items.item_text: Must be able to work weekends, occasional nights, and major holidays, during other staff's absence.
Be able to respond to emergencies after hours as needed.
Will be required to hold valid driver's license and have a driving record that is in accordance with local policies/procedures.
Must be able to acquire (AAUS) Scientific Diver SCUBA certification with Scripps Institution of Oceanography within 6 months of hire.

Duties may require direct contact with children (defined as individuals under the age of 18); completion of the Child Abuse and Neglect Reporting Act (CANRA) training will be required. Must meet CANRA compliance requirement per California Child Abuse and Neglect Reporting Act (“CANRA,” Penal Code sections 11164-11174.4).Job offer is contingent upon satisfactory clearance based on Background Check results.

Bachelor of Science in Biology or related field and/or equivalent experience. Demonstrated college level knowledge of avian husbandry, marine biology, fisheries science, and/or ecology and/or 3+ years of penguin husbandry experience in a public zoo or aquarium
Hands-on experience with penguin health assessments, restraint and treatments
Experience with avian incubation and rearing practices .
Experience in public tours, animal ambassador programs or guest experience with public zoo or aquarium
Serves as coverage to other Aquarists in Husbandry area (fishes, invertebrates, diving, life support and reptile)
Dives in exhibits to clean and maintain AAUS/Cal OSHA diving standards.
Assists in directing the activities of Assistant Aquarists, interns, and volunteers.
Knowledge of operant conditioning techniques prior to training animals.
Demonstrated organization skills: ability to keep accurate, consistent records relating to all aspects of animal Care and systems maintenance.
Proven ability to work well with others supporting, facilitating, and participating in a team.
Proven verbal and written communication skills.
Demonstrated knowledge of aquarium water quality parameters. The protocols in testing and in making adjustments.
Must possess strong observational skills to ensure animal health and safety.
